text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I find myself as Sweep Tosho's
familiar on her quest to learn
racing magic.
In other words, I became her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope. I don't wanna run on wood chips
today. Not feeling it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If I don't wanna, I don't wanna! Nooo
meanssss nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honestly,
the current situation is far from
ideal. At this rate, getting
Sweep Tosho to
make her official debut might prove to be
a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her refusal to listen to me probably comes
from a long history of
distrusting her
teachers and mentors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, earning Sweep Tosho's trust is
far from easy. The days spent testing
various methods to no avail start to
take a toll on my
sleep schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I wait hours on end for her to
feel inclined to train, and yet
another
day—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I don't wanna see another
track today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So instead, I bring Sweep Tosho
somewhere new for a change of
pace.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, "Limited-Edition Fresh Honeyade"?
Well... it looks okay, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph,
I'll drink it if you insist. But I don't
wanna line up. Go buy it
for me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait! C'mon familiar, what're you
yawning like that for?! It's bad
manners!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I earn myself another scolding for that
yawn before heading to the
back of the
line. Maybe this fatigue is catching up to
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The line is impressively long—probably
because they're selling limited-edition
drinks. Either way,
all I have to do is wait it
out...

text_block_list.name: Tall Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it again—five drinks,
one for each
of my friends!

text_block_list.name: Store Employee
text_block_list.text:
M-my apologies. Fresh Honeyade is a
limited-edition product, so
each customer
may only purchase up to two drinks at a
time...

text_block_list.name: Strong Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I ain't here for yer excuses!
The customer's
always right! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Two high school Umamusume are arguing
with the store employee!
And things are
getting real tense...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's she—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You an idiot or something?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's clearly written right here, "Only two drinks per person"! These huge letters too small for you to read? Do you even have eyes?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Also, if you idiots buy them all out,
there'll
be no more left for me!
Try using your
head for once, will you?!

text_block_list.name: Strong Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The hell's up with this brat? And
what's the weird hat for?
Shaddup and get
lost.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Weird hat? Grandma gave me this hat—it's proof that I'm a magical girl... And you called it WEIRD?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thaaat's it,
I've had it with you! Let's settle
this with a race! I'll show
you who should
really shut up!

text_block_list.name: Tall Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're on, brat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I muster up all my courage and step in
between them. It's too late to
stop this
feud, but at least...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to calm down both sides, who look
like they're about to sprint off
at any
moment...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I manage to borrow the track
where amateur runners hold
unofficial
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prevent any unwanted fisticuffs,
I place myself in between Sweep
Tosho and the
other Umamusume before explaining the
rules.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without bothering to respond, the two
head towards the starting
gate. Before
sending off Sweep Tosho, I steel myself
and tell her...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even if it's in the middle of the
race?
You might get hurt real
bad, y'know? I
don't—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...What was that all about? Making it
sound like I'd definitely win if
nothing
strange happens.)

text_block_list.name: Tall Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you're just a brat! A slow one, too!
Don't mind me, just passin'
through!

text_block_list.name: Strong Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you who should really shut up,"
was it? Don't make me
laugh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Urghhh, I'd win this even without your
help! There's no way I'm losing
to a pair of
annoying jerks like these two!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... I see it—the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(I...
I gotta win! I'll leave those dimwits in
the dust!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Because the strongest one here— is
meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Opponents
text_block_list.text: What?! N-no waaay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, did you see that just now?! She had
a crazy burst of speed at
the end there!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! That was like so, super hype!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Huh? I feel like... really good?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Is it because I put those numbskulls in
their place? No, it's not just
that—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the high schoolers come
and apologize, and then I go
right to
Sweep—her running was a sight to behold.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, that reminds me,
the first time we met
they also...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, familiar?
Aren't you wobbling a little
bit? You okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wha—familiar?! Hey! Say something,
dummy! Answer meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I realize there's no more need to
worry, my pent-up fatigue hits
me all at
once—and before I know it, my
consciousness fades.
